notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for a successful regional interaction service report. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard MIM data elements, DDM handles, and the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, DDM FOM, dimensions, standard MIM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies the typed HLAreportServiceInvocation payload, regional application delivery, source-region metadata, tag, producer, and transportation identity without provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador regional SendInteractionWithRegions service-reporting controls and FederateAmbassador service-report/application delivery
